purpose: Build complete training-set membership indices without materializing multi-million-structure datasets in memory or adding a persistent database service.

storage.engine: sorted flat files plus JSON metadata
storage.build_mode: single-pass normalized spool followed by bounded external chunk sort
storage.publication: atomic directory rename after complete build
storage.failure_policy: temporary build directory is removed; no partial production index is published

query_support.record_identity: duplicate record IDs fail closed during build
query_support.near_duplicate_prefilter: bucketed composition_key + site_count lookup returning source locators
query_support.near_duplicate_final_decision: must be performed by the frozen structure-comparison protocol against source structures
